dogecoin.text: After conversation with @PotatoMcGruff I am happy to announce the following: I took a position as Chief Analysis Officer for $DOGE. As my duty starts today, I will be sharing thorough analysis and perspectives on the cryptomarkets and $DOGE.
@kitharass @PotatoMcGruff It's up, BTC movement will be very important to consider in $DOGE price action, as that applies to all alts.

$DOGE update:

With big BTC rallies and crashes, a huge dip across the whole market was to be expected. This will never change until we get some proper decoupling between alts and BTC. Looking at some weekly support and resistances, I'm glad we held 51 sats, resistance at 81. https://t.co/d0cc4MnxbL

Very busy past couple of days, but I thought I'd share some $DOGE TA. Here's what I'm looking at:
1. Still respecting range, not too much out of the ordinary price action, even with BTC.
2. Approaching important 59 support area.
3. Potential H&S that can fill out.

Trade safely! https://t.co/55cZQ72WHY

I will still be posting $DOGE updates, as well as altcoin opportunities whenever I spot one. As BTC is pressuring the alt markets a lot now, I don't expect to see a lot of major gems in the near future, but I guess we will see :). BTC remains dominant for now.

$DOGE update:
Not much changed, ranging between 59 and 70 sats.
Two scenarios imo:

1. Hidden bullish divergence playing out, initiating next rally. (bullish scenario)
2. H&S pattern filling out, combined with RSI analysis. (bearish scenario)

RSI makes me hesitant about DOGE atm https://t.co/fxVfsQ4sb4

@kitharass I might be a $DOGE lover, but that doesn't mean I listen to a boss. We Shiba's deserve more respect ;)
Anyway, I still stand by my last analysis on $DOGE, there have been no new changes in circumstance.

$DOGE update:
Daily candle close at the bottom of the range (59 sats)
Held his own against the BTC dip today, but I would be very bearish if we close below 59 sats tomorrow.

$DOGE update:
Daily close below 59 satoshi support :(. No volume either way though. Might be a slow downhill decline from here, we might still go for a big final rally. Up in the air at this point. Leaning more to the bearish side myself. https://t.co/mPndbCHSBw

$DOGE update:
Mentioned in the Bitcoin masons chat I exited the remainder of my position at 58 sats after the Daily close below 59. Closed right at the 51 sats weekly support level. Breaking 51 (with increasing volume for confirmation) would complete an H&S pattern. Very bearish. https://t.co/IXXUcJ2jSa
